profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. Its AI efforts are centered on Apple Intelligence, which the company describes as helpful AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in personal context, and private at every step. According to the company's site, next-generation Apple Intelligence and Siri are coming later this year to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27.

Apple Intelligence powers a rebooted Siri AI that the company says supports open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversation, on-screen visual queries, writing generation and feedback, and in-app actions across Messages, Music, Reminders, and other apps. The site also describes Apple Intelligence capabilities in the Home app, including summarizing HomeKit Secure Video footage and AI-based clip search. The company emphasizes on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute as privacy mechanisms across Apple Intelligence, and the same on-device, privacy-first approach is noted for Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI, both of which apply AI to video editing on Apple silicon.

Apple reported revenue of approximately $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, and trades on a public exchange under the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. Two MCP servers are associated with the company in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
